lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼一直看著電腦？看起來好擔心。
lines.simplified: 你怎么一直看着电脑？看起来好担心。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme yìzhí kànzhe diànnǎo? Kàn qǐlái hǎo dānxīn.
lines.english: Why do you keep staring at the computer? You look really worried.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我的電腦突然打不開了。明天早上要交的報告都在裡面，這下子麻煩了。
lines.simplified: 我的电脑突然打不开了。明天早上要交的报告都在里面，这下子麻烦了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo túrán dǎ bù kāi le. Míngtiān zǎoshàng yào jiāo de bàogào dōu zài lǐmiàn, zhèxiàzi máfán le.
lines.english: My computer suddenly won't start. The report due tomorrow morning is all in it. Now I'm in trouble.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你沒有存一份在雲端嗎？
lines.simplified: 你没有存一份在云端吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ méiyǒu cún yí fèn zài yúnduān ma?
lines.english: Didn't you save a copy in the cloud?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上個星期存過一次，可是後來寫的都沒存。
lines.simplified: 上个星期存过一次，可是后来写的都没存。
lines.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqí cún guo yí cì, kěshì hòulái xiě de dōu méi cún.
lines.english: I saved it once last week, but nothing I wrote after that.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那拿去修呢？
lines.simplified: 那拿去修呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà ná qù xiū ne?
lines.english: What about getting it repaired?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 修電腦的人說，最快也要三天才能修好。
lines.simplified: 修电脑的人说，最快也要三天才能修好。
lines.pinyin: Xiū diànnǎo de rén shuō, zuì kuài yě yào sān tiān cái néng xiū hǎo.
lines.english: The repair person says it will take three days at the earliest.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的今天晚上最好怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的今天晚上最好怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de jīntiān wǎnshàng zuìhǎo zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What would be best for the man to do tonight?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 等電腦修好，再拿出原來的報告
choices.simplified: 等电脑修好，再拿出原来的报告
choices.pinyin: Děng diànnǎo xiū hǎo, zài ná chū yuánlái de bàogào.
choices.english: Wait for the repair, then take out the original report.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先下載雲端上的，再重寫後面的
choices.simplified: 先下载云端上的，再重写后面的
choices.pinyin: Xiān xiàzài yúnduān shàng de, zài chóng xiě hòumiàn de.
choices.english: Download the cloud copy, then rewrite the later part.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 從雲端下載整份報告交出去
choices.simplified: 从云端下载整份报告交出去
choices.pinyin: Cóng yúnduān xiàzài zhěng fèn bàogào jiāo chūqù.
choices.english: Download the whole report from the cloud and hand it in.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 今天晚上把整份報告重寫一次
choices.simplified: 今天晚上把整份报告重写一次
choices.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshàng bǎ zhěng fèn bàogào chóng xiě yí cì.
choices.english: Rewrite the whole report tonight.

questions.why: 這下子麻煩了 reacts to the dead computer. The repair takes three days but the report is due tomorrow morning, and the cloud holds last week's copy, so the best plan is to download it and rewrite only what came after. Waiting for the repair misses the deadline, the cloud copy is not the whole report, and rewriting everything throws away the saved part.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳不是要搭今天晚上的飛機去日本嗎？怎麼還在這裡？
lines.simplified: 你不是要搭今天晚上的飞机去日本吗？怎么还在这里？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì yào dā jīntiān wǎnshàng de fēijī qù Rìběn ma? Zěnme hái zài zhèlǐ?
lines.english: Weren't you flying to Japan tonight? Why are you still here?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 颱風來了，今天的飛機都不飛了，我的改到後天早上。
lines.simplified: 台风来了，今天的飞机都不飞了，我的改到后天早上。
lines.pinyin: Táifēng lái le, jīntiān de fēijī dōu bù fēi le, wǒ de gǎi dào hòutiān zǎoshàng.
lines.english: The typhoon's here. No planes are flying today; mine has moved to the morning after tomorrow.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這下子妳明天的會議怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 这下子你明天的会议怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Zhèxiàzi nǐ míngtiān de huìyì zěnme bàn?
lines.english: So what about your meeting tomorrow now?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 還好對方說可以在網路上開，我在家就能參加。
lines.simplified: 还好对方说可以在网路上开，我在家就能参加。
lines.pinyin: Háihǎo duìfāng shuō kěyǐ zài wǎnglù shàng kāi, wǒ zài jiā jiù néng cānjiā.
lines.english: Luckily they said we can hold it online, so I can join from home.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的說「這下子妳明天的會議怎麼辦」，是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的说「这下子你明天的会议怎么办」，是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shuō "zhèxiàzi nǐ míngtiān de huìyì zěnme bàn", shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean by "so what about your meeting tomorrow now"?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 擔心她明天沒辦法去開會
choices.simplified: 担心她明天没办法去开会
choices.pinyin: Dānxīn tā míngtiān méi bànfǎ qù kāihuì.
choices.english: He worries she can't be at the meeting tomorrow.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 覺得會議應該改到後天
choices.simplified: 觉得会议应该改到后天
choices.pinyin: Juéde huìyì yīnggāi gǎi dào hòutiān.
choices.english: He thinks the meeting should move to the day after.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想知道網路上的會怎麼開
choices.simplified: 想知道网路上的会怎么开
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng zhīdào wǎnglù shàng de huì zěnme kāi.
choices.english: He wants to know how the online meeting works.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 擔心後天的飛機也不飛
choices.simplified: 担心后天的飞机也不飞
choices.pinyin: Dānxīn hòutiān de fēijī yě bù fēi.
choices.english: He worries the later flight won't fly either.

questions.why: 這下子 reacts to the news just given: her flight is now the day after tomorrow, so he worries she will miss tomorrow's meeting in Japan. It is the flight, not the meeting, that moved; the online meeting is her answer, not his question; and he says nothing about the new flight.

focus.en: now (a reaction to what just happened)

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 明天馬博士的演講你還去嗎？氣象預報說明天會下大雨。
lines.simplified: 明天马博士的演讲你还去吗？气象预报说明天会下大雨。
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān Mǎ bóshì de yǎnjiǎng nǐ hái qù ma? Qìxiàng yùbào shuō míngtiān huì xià dà yǔ.
lines.english: Are you still going to Dr. Ma's talk tomorrow? The weather report says heavy rain.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 當然去。這個題目我研究很久了，就是雨下得再大，我也要去聽。
lines.simplified: 当然去。这个题目我研究很久了，就是雨下得再大，我也要去听。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán qù. Zhège tímù wǒ yánjiù hěn jiǔ le, jiùshì yǔ xià de zài dà, wǒ yě yào qù tīng.
lines.english: Of course. I've studied this topic for ages. Even if it pours, I'm going.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是演講的地方在山上，你又要騎摩托車，太危險了。影片以後會上傳，在家看不就好了？
lines.simplified: 可是演讲的地方在山上，你又要骑摩托车，太危险了。影片以后会上传，在家看不就好了？
lines.pinyin: Kěshì yǎnjiǎng de dìfāng zài shān shàng, nǐ yòu yào qí mótuōchē, tài wéixiǎn le. Yǐngpiàn yǐhòu huì shàngchuán, zài jiā kàn bú jiù hǎo le?
lines.english: But the talk is up in the hills and you'd go by motorcycle. That's too dangerous. The video will be uploaded later; why not just watch it at home?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 在家看就不能當面問問題了。不過騎車真的太危險，我改搭公車，早一點出門。
lines.simplified: 在家看就不能当面问问题了。不过骑车真的太危险，我改搭公车，早一点出门。
lines.pinyin: Zài jiā kàn jiù bù néng dāngmiàn wèn wèntí le. Búguò qí chē zhēn de tài wéixiǎn, wǒ gǎi dā gōngchē, zǎo yìdiǎn chūmén.
lines.english: At home I couldn't ask questions in person. But riding really is too dangerous; I'll take the bus instead and leave earlier.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說了她的擔心以後，男的最後決定怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 女的说了她的担心以后，男的最后决定怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō le tā de dānxīn yǐhòu, nán de zuìhòu juédìng zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: After the woman voices her worries, what does the man finally decide to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 改成在家看演講的影片
choices.simplified: 改成在家看演讲的影片
choices.pinyin: Gǎi chéng zài jiā kàn yǎnjiǎng de yǐngpiàn.
choices.english: He'll watch the video at home instead.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 騎車去，可是要早一點出門
choices.simplified: 骑车去，可是要早一点出门
choices.pinyin: Qí chē qù, kěshì yào zǎo yìdiǎn chūmén.
choices.english: He'll ride there but leave earlier.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 還是要去，但是不騎車了
choices.simplified: 还是要去，但是不骑车了
choices.pinyin: Háishì yào qù, dànshì bù qí chē le.
choices.english: He still goes, but not by motorcycle.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 搭公車去，所以能晚點出門
choices.simplified: 搭公车去，所以能晚点出门
choices.pinyin: Dā gōngchē qù, suǒyǐ néng wǎn diǎn chūmén.
choices.english: He'll take the bus, so he can leave later.

questions.why: 就是雨下得再大，我也要去 means the rain will not stop him, so he turns down watching at home (he wants to ask questions in person); what her warning changes is only how he travels. Watching the video is her idea, which he rejects; the motorcycle is dropped; and the bus means leaving earlier, not later.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我送爺爺一台平板，還幫他下載了很多電子書，他卻一次也沒用過。
lines.simplified: 我送爷爷一台平板，还帮他下载了很多电子书，他却一次也没用过。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ sòng yéye yì tái píngbǎn, hái bāng tā xiàzài le hěn duō diànzǐshū, tā què yí cì yě méi yòng guo.
lines.english: I gave Grandpa a tablet and downloaded lots of e-books for him, yet he hasn't used it once.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 是不是字太小，他看不清楚？
lines.simplified: 是不是字太小，他看不清楚？
lines.pinyin: Shì bú shì zì tài xiǎo, tā kàn bù qīngchǔ?
lines.english: Is the print too small for him to see?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 字可以變大啊。他說電子書就是再方便，他也還是喜歡去圖書館借書回家看。
lines.simplified: 字可以变大啊。他说电子书就是再方便，他也还是喜欢去图书馆借书回家看。
lines.pinyin: Zì kěyǐ biàn dà a. Tā shuō diànzǐshū jiùshì zài fāngbiàn, tā yě háishì xǐhuān qù túshūguǎn jiè shū huíjiā kàn.
lines.english: The print can be made bigger. He says however convenient e-books are, he still likes borrowing books from the library to read at home.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那就讓他去吧，去圖書館走走對身體也好。
lines.simplified: 那就让他去吧，去图书馆走走对身体也好。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù ràng tā qù ba, qù túshūguǎn zǒuzou duì shēntǐ yě hǎo.
lines.english: Then let him go. A walk to the library is good for him too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 爺爺對電子書的看法是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 爷爷对电子书的看法是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Yéye duì diànzǐshū de kànfǎ shì shénme?
prompt.english: What does Grandpa think of e-books?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 字太小，看起來很累
choices.simplified: 字太小，看起来很累
choices.pinyin: Zì tài xiǎo, kàn qǐlái hěn lèi.
choices.english: The print is too small and tiring to read.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 下載太麻煩，不想學
choices.simplified: 下载太麻烦，不想学
choices.pinyin: Xiàzài tài máfán, bù xiǎng xué.
choices.english: Downloading is too much trouble to learn.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 比去圖書館借書方便
choices.simplified: 比去图书馆借书方便
choices.pinyin: Bǐ qù túshūguǎn jiè shū fāngbiàn.
choices.english: They are handier than going to the library.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 方便是方便，可是他不想用
choices.simplified: 方便是方便，可是他不想用
choices.pinyin: Fāngbiàn shì fāngbiàn, kěshì tā bù xiǎng yòng.
choices.english: They are convenient, but he doesn't want to use them.

questions.why: 就是再方便 grants that e-books are convenient, and 他也還是喜歡去圖書館 says that will not change his habit. Small print was only the man's guess and the print can be enlarged, the granddaughter did the downloading, and "handier" is only half his view: he still prefers the library.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說妳拒絕了那家大公司？他們薪水高，離妳家又近，以後機會也多。
lines.simplified: 听说你拒绝了那家大公司？他们薪水高，离你家又近，以后机会也多。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ jùjué le nà jiā dà gōngsī? Tāmen xīnshuǐ gāo, lí nǐ jiā yòu jìn, yǐhòu jīhuì yě duō.
lines.english: I hear you turned down that big company? The pay is high, it's close to your home, and there are more chances later on.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 是啊，可是那裡每天都要加班到很晚，週末也常常得去公司。
lines.simplified: 是啊，可是那里每天都要加班到很晚，周末也常常得去公司。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, kěshì nàlǐ měi tiān dōu yào jiābān dào hěn wǎn, zhōumò yě chángcháng děi qù gōngsī.
lines.english: Yes, but there you work late every day and often have to go in at weekends.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳選的那家呢？
lines.simplified: 那你选的那家呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ xuǎn de nà jiā ne?
lines.english: And the one you chose?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 儘管薪水少一點，坐車也要四十分鐘，但是每天六點就下班了。我可不想每天回到家只能睡覺。
lines.simplified: 尽管薪水少一点，坐车也要四十分钟，但是每天六点就下班了。我可不想每天回到家只能睡觉。
lines.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn xīnshuǐ shǎo yìdiǎn, zuò chē yě yào sìshí fēnzhōng, dànshì měi tiān liù diǎn jiù xiàbān le. Wǒ kě bù xiǎng měi tiān huí dào jiā zhǐ néng shuìjiào.
lines.english: Even though the pay is a bit lower and the ride takes forty minutes, I finish at six every day. I really don't want to get home every night with nothing left but sleep.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的選工作的時候，最重視的是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的选工作的时候，最重视的是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de xuǎn gōngzuò de shíhòu, zuì zhòngshì de shì shénme?
prompt.english: What matters most to the woman in choosing a job?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 公司給的薪水高不高
choices.simplified: 公司给的薪水高不高
choices.pinyin: Gōngsī gěi de xīnshuǐ gāo bù gāo.
choices.english: How high the pay is.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 公司離家近不近
choices.simplified: 公司离家近不近
choices.pinyin: Gōngsī lí jiā jìn bú jìn.
choices.english: How close the company is to home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 以後的機會多不多
choices.simplified: 以后的机会多不多
choices.pinyin: Yǐhòu de jīhuì duō bù duō.
choices.english: How many chances there are later on.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 下班後有沒有自己的時間
choices.simplified: 下班后有没有自己的时间
choices.pinyin: Xiàbān hòu yǒu méiyǒu zìjǐ de shíjiān.
choices.english: Whether she has time of her own after work.

questions.why: The big company wins on pay, distance and future chances, yet she turned it down because of late nights and weekends; 儘管 then grants the new job's lower pay and longer ride and turns to what she gains: she finishes at six and does not want evenings that are only for sleep, so what she wants is time of her own. So pay, distance and chances all lost out to her own time.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你透過網路認識的那個朋友，你們見過面了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你透过网路认识的那个朋友，你们见过面了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ tòuguò wǎnglù rènshì de nàge péngyǒu, nǐmen jiàn guo miàn le ma?
lines.english: That friend you met online, have you met in person yet?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 見了。他在網路上說自己很會做菜，見面的時候卻說他從來沒做過菜。
lines.simplified: 见了。他在网路上说自己很会做菜，见面的时候却说他从来没做过菜。
lines.pinyin: Jiàn le. Tā zài wǎnglù shàng shuō zìjǐ hěn huì zuò cài, jiànmiàn de shíhòu què shuō tā cónglái méi zuò guo cài.
lines.english: We did. Online he said he was a great cook, yet when we met he said he had never cooked.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那他說自己是大學生，是真的嗎？
lines.simplified: 那他说自己是大学生，是真的吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà tā shuō zìjǐ shì dàxuéshēng, shì zhēn de ma?
lines.english: And is it true that he's a university student?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那倒是真的，他還帶我去看了他的學校。至於他說住在臺北，我就不知道了，他一直不肯說住哪裡。
lines.simplified: 那倒是真的，他还带我去看了他的学校。至于他说住在台北，我就不知道了，他一直不肯说住哪里。
lines.pinyin: Nà dàoshì zhēn de, tā hái dài wǒ qù kàn le tā de xuéxiào. Zhìyú tā shuō zhù zài Táiběi, wǒ jiù bù zhīdào le, tā yìzhí bù kěn shuō zhù nǎlǐ.
lines.english: That part is true; he even showed me his university. As for living in Taipei, I can't say. He never would tell me where he lives.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 聽完對話，下面哪一個說法是對的？
prompt.simplified: 听完对话，下面哪一个说法是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Tīng wán duìhuà, xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shuōfǎ shì duì de?
prompt.english: After the conversation, which statement is right?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他說的話不能全信
choices.simplified: 他说的话不能全信
choices.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà bù néng quán xìn.
choices.english: Not everything he says can be believed.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他說的一句也不能信
choices.simplified: 他说的一句也不能信
choices.pinyin: Tā shuō de yí jù yě bù néng xìn.
choices.english: Not a word he says can be believed.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他其實真的很會做菜
choices.simplified: 他其实真的很会做菜
choices.pinyin: Tā qíshí zhēn de hěn huì zuò cài.
choices.english: He really is a good cook.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他不是真的大學生
choices.simplified: 他不是真的大学生
choices.pinyin: Tā bú shì zhēn de dàxuéshēng.
choices.english: He isn't really a student.

questions.why: The cooking was untrue (卻說他從來沒做過菜), the student part is true (倒是真的), and with 至於 the man sets Taipei apart as unknown: some of it is true and some is not. So not "every word" is false, the cooking claim fell apart, and the student claim was confirmed.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 哥哥說他今年在美國工作，沒辦法回來幫奶奶過生日。
lines.simplified: 哥哥说他今年在美国工作，没办法回来帮奶奶过生日。
lines.pinyin: Gēge shuō tā jīnnián zài Měiguó gōngzuò, méi bànfǎ huílái bāng nǎinai guò shēngrì.
lines.english: My brother says he's working in America this year and can't come back for Grandma's birthday.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那讓他用手機上網跟奶奶聊天吧，奶奶還能看到他。
lines.simplified: 那让他用手机上网跟奶奶聊天吧，奶奶还能看到他。
lines.pinyin: Nà ràng tā yòng shǒujī shàngwǎng gēn nǎinai liáotiān ba, nǎinai hái néng kàn dào tā.
lines.english: Then let him chat with Grandma online on a phone. She'll even be able to see him.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 奶奶連接電話都不太會，更別說用手機上網了。
lines.simplified: 奶奶连接电话都不太会，更别说用手机上网了。
lines.pinyin: Nǎinai lián jiē diànhuà dōu bú tài huì, gèng bié shuō yòng shǒujī shàngwǎng le.
lines.english: Grandma can barely answer a phone call, let alone go online on one.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那我來教她。學會了以後，她想哥哥的時候，隨時都能看到他。
lines.simplified: 那我来教她。学会了以后，她想哥哥的时候，随时都能看到他。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ lái jiāo tā. Xué huì le yǐhòu, tā xiǎng gēge de shíhòu, suíshí dōu néng kàn dào tā.
lines.english: Then I'll teach her. Once she's learned, she can see him whenever she misses him.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好啊。我們也可以把家裡的照片上傳到雲端，讓哥哥下載。
lines.simplified: 好啊。我们也可以把家里的照片上传到云端，让哥哥下载。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a. Wǒmen yě kěyǐ bǎ jiālǐ de zhàopiàn shàngchuán dào yúnduān, ràng gēge xiàzài.
lines.english: All right. We could also upload the family photos to the cloud for him to download.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這個主意好，既不用花錢，又能讓他知道家裡最近的生活。
lines.simplified: 这个主意好，既不用花钱，又能让他知道家里最近的生活。
lines.pinyin: Zhège zhǔyì hǎo, jì bú yòng huā qián, yòu néng ràng tā zhīdào jiālǐ zuìjìn de shēnghuó.
lines.english: Good idea. It costs nothing, and it lets him know what life at home is like lately.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我這個週末回去，先替奶奶換一支新手機。
lines.simplified: 那我这个周末回去，先替奶奶换一支新手机。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ zhège zhōumò huíqù, xiān tì nǎinai huàn yì zhī xīn shǒujī.
lines.english: Then I'll go home this weekend and first get Grandma a new phone.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對，舊的那支字那麼小，她本來就看不清楚，我教了也沒用。
lines.simplified: 对，旧的那支字那么小，她本来就看不清楚，我教了也没用。
lines.pinyin: Duì, jiù de nà zhī zì nàme xiǎo, tā běnlái jiù kàn bù qīngchǔ, wǒ jiāo le yě méi yòng.
lines.english: Right. The old one's print is so small she couldn't read it anyway; teaching her on it would be no use.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的建議讓哥哥上網跟奶奶聊天，女的為什麼覺得不容易？
prompt.simplified: 男的建议让哥哥上网跟奶奶聊天，女的为什么觉得不容易？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de jiànyì ràng gēge shàngwǎng gēn nǎinai liáotiān, nǚ de wèishénme juéde bù róngyì?
prompt.english: The man suggests her brother chat with Grandma online. Why does the woman think it won't be easy?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 哥哥在美國工作沒有空
choices.simplified: 哥哥在美国工作没有空
choices.pinyin: Gēge zài Měiguó gōngzuò méiyǒu kòng.
choices.english: Her brother is too busy working in America.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 上網聊天得花不少錢
choices.simplified: 上网聊天得花不少钱
choices.pinyin: Shàngwǎng liáotiān děi huā bù shǎo qián.
choices.english: Chatting online would cost a lot.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 奶奶連最基本的都還不會
choices.simplified: 奶奶连最基本的都还不会
choices.pinyin: Nǎinai lián zuì jīběn de dōu hái bú huì.
choices.english: Grandma can't yet do even the most basic thing.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 奶奶連電話都不喜歡接
choices.simplified: 奶奶连电话都不喜欢接
choices.pinyin: Nǎinai lián diànhuà dōu bù xǐhuān jiē.
choices.english: Grandma doesn't even like answering the phone.

questions.why: 連接電話都不太會，更別說用手機上網了: if even answering a call is beyond her, going online is clearly harder. It is about what she can do, not what she likes (不太會, not 不喜歡); her brother's work is why he cannot fly home, not why a call is hard; and money comes up only later, about the photos, which are free.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼要先替奶奶換手機？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么要先替奶奶换手机？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme yào xiān tì nǎinai huàn shǒujī?
prompt.english: Why does the woman want to get Grandma a new phone first?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 讓奶奶看得清楚，才學得會
choices.simplified: 让奶奶看得清楚，才学得会
choices.pinyin: Ràng nǎinai kàn de qīngchǔ, cái xué de huì.
choices.english: So Grandma can see clearly and then learn.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 給奶奶當生日禮物
choices.simplified: 给奶奶当生日礼物
choices.pinyin: Gěi nǎinai dāng shēngrì lǐwù.
choices.english: As Grandma's birthday present.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 舊手機沒辦法上網
choices.simplified: 旧手机没办法上网
choices.pinyin: Jiù shǒujī méi bànfǎ shàngwǎng.
choices.english: The old phone can't go online.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 男的週末就要開始教她
choices.simplified: 男的周末就要开始教她
choices.pinyin: Nán de zhōumò jiù yào kāishǐ jiāo tā.
choices.english: The man starts teaching her this weekend.

questions.why: She gives no reason herself; the man's reply supplies it: the old phone's print is too small for Grandma, so his lessons on it would be no use. Nobody calls the phone a birthday present, nobody says the old one cannot go online, and no day is set for his lessons.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼覺得上傳照片是好主意？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么觉得上传照片是好主意？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme juéde shàngchuán zhàopiàn shì hǎo zhǔyì?
prompt.english: Why does the man think uploading the photos is a good idea?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 奶奶隨時都能看到哥哥
choices.simplified: 奶奶随时都能看到哥哥
choices.pinyin: Nǎinai suíshí dōu néng kàn dào gēge.
choices.english: Grandma can see her brother anytime.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 奶奶就不用學怎麼上網了
choices.simplified: 奶奶就不用学怎么上网了
choices.pinyin: Nǎinai jiù bú yòng xué zěnme shàngwǎng le.
choices.english: Grandma won't need to learn to go online.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 家人能看到哥哥在美國的生活
choices.simplified: 家人能看到哥哥在美国的生活
choices.pinyin: Jiārén néng kàn dào gēge zài Měiguó de shēnghuó.
choices.english: The family can see his life in America.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 哥哥人不在，也知道家裡的事
choices.simplified: 哥哥人不在，也知道家里的事
choices.pinyin: Gēge rén bú zài, yě zhīdào jiālǐ de shì.
choices.english: Her brother can keep up with home though he's away.

questions.why: 既不用花錢，又能讓他知道家裡最近的生活: free, and better still, it keeps her brother in touch with home. Seeing him anytime is what the online calls are for, Grandma still has to learn (the man is teaching her), and the photos go from home to him, not the other way.

focus.en: both… and…; telling two plans apart

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說公司下個月起，星期五可以在家上班了？
lines.simplified: 听说公司下个月起，星期五可以在家上班了？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō gōngsī xià ge yuè qǐ, xīngqíwǔ kěyǐ zài jiā shàngbān le?
lines.english: I hear that from next month we can work from home on Fridays?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，大家在網路上開會就可以了。主任說這樣能幫公司省錢。
lines.simplified: 对啊，大家在网路上开会就可以了。主任说这样能帮公司省钱。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, dàjiā zài wǎnglù shàng kāihuì jiù kěyǐ le. Zhǔrèn shuō zhèyàng néng bāng gōngsī shěng qián.
lines.english: Yes, we just meet online. The head says it saves the company money.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 太好了，我既不用早起，又能省下坐車的兩個小時。
lines.simplified: 太好了，我既不用早起，又能省下坐车的两个小时。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le, wǒ jì bú yòng zǎo qǐ, yòu néng shěng xià zuò chē de liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: Great. For me it means no early start, and better still, I save the two hours on the road.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我倒是有點擔心。我家的網路很慢，有時候連訊息都傳不出去，更別說在網路上開會了。
lines.simplified: 我倒是有点担心。我家的网路很慢，有时候连讯息都传不出去，更别说在网路上开会了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ dàoshì yǒudiǎn dānxīn. Wǒ jiā de wǎnglù hěn màn, yǒu shíhòu lián xùnxí dōu chuán bù chūqù, gèng bié shuō zài wǎnglù shàng kāihuì le.
lines.english: I'm a bit worried, though. My internet at home is slow; sometimes I can't even send a message, let alone join an online meeting.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 公司不是說會出錢，讓大家換高速網路嗎？
lines.simplified: 公司不是说会出钱，让大家换高速网路吗？
lines.pinyin: Gōngsī bú shì shuō huì chū qián, ràng dàjiā huàn gāosù wǎnglù ma?
lines.english: Didn't the company say it would pay for everyone to switch to high-speed internet?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 問題是我家那邊太偏僻，就是想換也換不了。
lines.simplified: 问题是我家那边太偏僻，就是想换也换不了。
lines.pinyin: Wèntí shì wǒ jiā nàbiān tài piānpì, jiùshì xiǎng huàn yě huàn bù liǎo.
lines.english: The problem is my place is too remote. Even if I want to switch, I can't.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那星期五妳還是來公司吧，辦公室還是會開。
lines.simplified: 那星期五你还是来公司吧，办公室还是会开。
lines.pinyin: Nà xīngqíwǔ nǐ háishì lái gōngsī ba, bàngōngshì háishì huì kāi.
lines.english: Then come to the office on Fridays anyway. It will still be open.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 也只能這樣了。在公司也是在網路上開會，其實沒什麼不一樣。
lines.simplified: 也只能这样了。在公司也是在网路上开会，其实没什么不一样。
lines.pinyin: Yě zhǐ néng zhèyàng le. Zài gōngsī yě shì zài wǎnglù shàng kāihuì, qíshí méi shénme bù yíyàng.
lines.english: I suppose that's all I can do. At the office I'd be meeting online too, so it's not really any different.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 兩個人對星期五在家上班的反應為什麼不一樣？
prompt.simplified: 两个人对星期五在家上班的反应为什么不一样？
prompt.pinyin: Liǎng ge rén duì xīngqíwǔ zài jiā shàngbān de fǎnyìng wèishénme bù yíyàng?
prompt.english: Why do the two react differently to working from home on Fridays?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他想幫公司省錢，她怕花錢
choices.simplified: 他想帮公司省钱，她怕花钱
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng bāng gōngsī shěng qián, tā pà huā qián.
choices.english: He wants to save the company money; she fears the cost.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他能少坐車，她家網路太慢
choices.simplified: 他能少坐车，她家网路太慢
choices.pinyin: Tā néng shǎo zuò chē, tā jiā wǎnglù tài màn.
choices.english: He'll spend less time on the road; her internet is too slow.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他會用電腦，她不會上網開會
choices.simplified: 他会用电脑，她不会上网开会
choices.pinyin: Tā huì yòng diànnǎo, tā bú huì shàngwǎng kāihuì.
choices.english: He's good with computers; she can't do online meetings.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他住得遠，她喜歡到公司上班
choices.simplified: 他住得远，她喜欢到公司上班
choices.pinyin: Tā zhù de yuǎn, tā xǐhuān dào gōngsī shàngbān.
choices.english: He lives far away; she likes working at the office.

questions.why: He is glad for himself (既不用早起，又能省下坐車的兩個小時), while she worries because her line is so slow that even messages fail, 更別說 online meetings. Saving money is the head's reason and the company pays for internet; her problem is the connection, not her skill; and she comes to the office only because she has to.

focus.zh: 既……又……；更別說……了；比較兩人
focus.en: both… and…; let alone…; comparing two people

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼沒辦法換高速網路？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么没办法换高速网路？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme méi bànfǎ huàn gāosù wǎnglù?
prompt.english: Why can't the woman switch to high-speed internet?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 公司出的錢不夠付
choices.simplified: 公司出的钱不够付
choices.pinyin: Gōngsī chū de qián bú gòu fù.
choices.english: The company's money won't cover it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 公司的錢下個月才給
choices.simplified: 公司的钱下个月才给
choices.pinyin: Gōngsī de qián xià ge yuè cái gěi.
choices.english: The company pays only next month.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她家那裡沒有這種網路
choices.simplified: 她家那里没有这种网路
choices.pinyin: Tā jiā nàlǐ méiyǒu zhè zhǒng wǎnglù.
choices.english: Her area has no such service.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 主任不讓她在家上班
choices.simplified: 主任不让她在家上班
choices.pinyin: Zhǔrèn bú ràng tā zài jiā shàngbān.
choices.english: The head won't let her work from home.

questions.why: 就是想換也換不了: even wanting it, with the company paying, she cannot get it, because her place is 太偏僻. Nobody says the money falls short or comes late (next month is when the Fridays at home begin), and the head is not stopping her.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 對男的的建議，女的是什麼態度？
prompt.simplified: 对男的的建议，女的是什么态度？
prompt.pinyin: Duì nán de de jiànyì, nǚ de shì shénme tàidù?
prompt.english: What is the woman's attitude to the man's suggestion?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 沒有別的辦法，也還能接受
choices.simplified: 没有别的办法，也还能接受
choices.pinyin: Méiyǒu bié de bànfǎ, yě hái néng jiēshòu.
choices.english: There's no other way, but she can live with it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 很高興以後不用再坐車了
choices.simplified: 很高兴以后不用再坐车了
choices.pinyin: Hěn gāoxìng yǐhòu bú yòng zài zuò chē le.
choices.english: She's glad she needn't commute any more.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 覺得在公司開會比在家好
choices.simplified: 觉得在公司开会比在家好
choices.pinyin: Juéde zài gōngsī kāihuì bǐ zài jiā hǎo.
choices.english: She thinks meeting at the office beats home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 擔心在公司也開不了會
choices.simplified: 担心在公司也开不了会
choices.pinyin: Dānxīn zài gōngsī yě kāi bù liǎo huì.
choices.english: She worries she can't meet from the office either.

questions.why: 也只能這樣了 says she has no better choice, and 沒什麼不一樣 shows she does not much mind. Not commuting is the man's gain, she calls the office "no different", not better, and her worry was about home, not the office.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a broadcast, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 各位同學好，這裡是學校圖書館。
lines.simplified: 各位同学好，这里是学校图书馆。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi tóngxué hǎo, zhèlǐ shì xuéxiào túshūguǎn.
lines.english: Hello, everyone. This is the university library.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 從下個月一號起，圖書館要改用新的雲端系統，讓同學借電子書。
lines.simplified: 从下个月一号起，图书馆要改用新的云端系统，让同学借电子书。
lines.pinyin: Cóng xià ge yuè yī hào qǐ, túshūguǎn yào gǎi yòng xīn de yúnduān xìtǒng, ràng tóngxué jiè diànzǐshū.
lines.english: From the first of next month, the library is switching to a new cloud system for students to borrow e-books.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 同學只要用學校的電子信箱建立帳號，就能在手機上借書。
lines.simplified: 同学只要用学校的电子信箱建立帐号，就能在手机上借书。
lines.pinyin: Tóngxué zhǐyào yòng xuéxiào de diànzǐ xìnxiāng jiànlì zhànghào, jiù néng zài shǒujī shàng jiè shū.
lines.english: Just set up an account with your university email, and you can borrow on your phone.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 每個人一次最多借五本，每本可以看十四天。時間一到，系統就會自動還書。
lines.simplified: 每个人一次最多借五本，每本可以看十四天。时间一到，系统就会自动还书。
lines.pinyin: Měi ge rén yí cì zuì duō jiè wǔ běn, měi běn kěyǐ kàn shísì tiān. Shíjiān yí dào, xìtǒng jiù huì zìdòng huán shū.
lines.english: You can borrow up to five at a time and keep each for fourteen days. When time is up, the system returns the book automatically.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 還沒看完的話，可以在還書前三天內上網再借一次；不過，要是有別人在等這本書，就不能再借了。
lines.simplified: 还没看完的话，可以在还书前三天内上网再借一次；不过，要是有别人在等这本书，就不能再借了。
lines.pinyin: Hái méi kàn wán de huà, kěyǐ zài huán shū qián sān tiān nèi shàngwǎng zài jiè yí cì; búguò, yàoshi yǒu biérén zài děng zhè běn shū, jiù bù néng zài jiè le.
lines.english: If you haven't finished, you can borrow it once more online in the three days before it's due; but if someone else is waiting for the book, you can't.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們這麼做，一方面是因為圖書館的空間不夠，放不下更多的書，一方面也希望大家隨時隨地都能閱讀。
lines.simplified: 我们这么做，一方面是因为图书馆的空间不够，放不下更多的书，一方面也希望大家随时随地都能阅读。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen zhème zuò, yìfāngmiàn shì yīnwèi túshūguǎn de kōngjiān bú gòu, fàng bú xià gèng duō de shū, yìfāngmiàn yě xīwàng dàjiā suíshí suídì dōu néng yuèdú.
lines.english: We are doing this partly because the library is out of space and can't hold more books, and partly because we hope everyone can read anytime, anywhere.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 還有，三樓的閱讀室下個月要整理，暫時不開放，請大家先到二樓看書。
lines.simplified: 还有，三楼的阅读室下个月要整理，暂时不开放，请大家先到二楼看书。
lines.pinyin: Háiyǒu, sān lóu de yuèdú shì xià ge yuè yào zhěnglǐ, zhànshí bù kāifàng, qǐng dàjiā xiān dào èr lóu kàn shū.
lines.english: Also, the third-floor reading room will be reorganised next month and closed for now; please read on the second floor.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 一位同學借的電子書再兩天就要還了，可是他還沒看完。他可以怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 一位同学借的电子书再两天就要还了，可是他还没看完。他可以怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Yí wèi tóngxué jiè de diànzǐshū zài liǎng tiān jiù yào huán le, kěshì tā hái méi kàn wán. Tā kěyǐ zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: A student's e-book is due back in two days, but he hasn't finished it. What can he do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 系統會自動讓他多看幾天
choices.simplified: 系统会自动让他多看几天
choices.pinyin: Xìtǒng huì zìdòng ràng tā duō kàn jǐ tiān.
choices.english: The system will give him a few more days by itself.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 得到圖書館去才能再借
choices.simplified: 得到图书馆去才能再借
choices.pinyin: Děi dào túshūguǎn qù cái néng zài jiè.
choices.english: He must go to the library to borrow it again.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 可以上網把書多借三天
choices.simplified: 可以上网把书多借三天
choices.pinyin: Kěyǐ shàngwǎng bǎ shū duō jiè sān tiān.
choices.english: He can go online and keep it three days longer.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 沒人在等，就能上網再借
choices.simplified: 没人在等，就能上网再借
choices.pinyin: Méi rén zài děng, jiù néng shàngwǎng zài jiè.
choices.english: If no one is waiting for it, he can borrow it again online.

questions.why: Two days left is inside the three days before the due date, so he may borrow it again online, unless someone else is waiting for it. The system only returns books by itself, it never extends them; it is all done online; and three days is when he may borrow again, not how much longer he gets.

focus.en: applying a rule to a new case

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 圖書館為什麼要改用這個系統？

prompt.pinyin: Túshūguǎn wèishénme yào gǎi yòng zhège xìtǒng?
prompt.english: Why is the library switching to this system?

choices.speaker: N

choices.simplified: 三楼要整理，书暂时没地方放
choices.pinyin: Sān lóu yào zhěnglǐ, shū zhànshí méi dìfāng fàng.
choices.english: The third floor is being reorganised, so books have nowhere to go for now.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 書放不下了，也想讓大家隨時讀
choices.simplified: 书放不下了，也想让大家随时读
choices.pinyin: Shū fàng bú xià le, yě xiǎng ràng dàjiā suíshí dú.
choices.english: It's out of room for books and wants everyone to read anytime.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 同學常忘了還，想讓系統自動還
choices.simplified: 同学常忘了还，想让系统自动还
choices.pinyin: Tóngxué cháng wàng le huán, xiǎng ràng xìtǒng zìdòng huán.
choices.english: Students forget to return books, so the system will do it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想讓大家一次能多借幾本
choices.simplified: 想让大家一次能多借几本
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng ràng dàjiā yí cì néng duō jiè jǐ běn.
choices.english: It wants students to borrow more at a time.

questions.why: The two 一方面 give two reasons: a lasting lack of space and reading anytime, anywhere. The reading room closing is separate, temporary news after 還有; automatic returns are how the system works, not why it came; and five books is a limit, not an increase.

focus.zh: 一方面……一方面……；長期和暫時
focus.en: on one hand… on the other…; lasting vs temporary

choices.traditional: 以後借電子書的新方法

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 三樓的閱讀室暫時不開放
choices.simplified: 三楼的阅读室暂时不开放
choices.pinyin: Sān lóu de yuèdú shì zhànshí bù kāifàng.
choices.english: The third-floor reading room is closed for now.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 同學一次能借幾本書
choices.simplified: 同学一次能借几本书
choices.pinyin: Tóngxué yí cì néng jiè jǐ běn shū.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 怎麼在手機上閱讀
choices.simplified: 怎么在手机上阅读
choices.pinyin: Zěnme zài shǒujī shàng yuèdú.
choices.english: How to read on a phone.

questions.why: Most of the broadcast is the new cloud system: when it starts, how to sign up, how many books, how returns and borrowing again work, and why. The reading room is an add-on (還有), the number of books is one detail of it, and it explains borrowing, not reading.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a broadcast, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽眾朋友晚安。最近很多上班族在家裡裝了攝影機，透過手機就能看到家人在做什麼。
lines.simplified: 听众朋友晚安。最近很多上班族在家里装了摄影机，透过手机就能看到家人在做什么。
lines.pinyin: Tīngzhòng péngyǒu wǎn'ān. Zuìjìn hěn duō shàngbānzú zài jiālǐ zhuāng le shèyǐngjī, tòuguò shǒujī jiù néng kàn dào jiārén zài zuò shénme.
lines.english: Good evening, listeners. Lately many office workers have put cameras in their homes, so they can see on their phones what their families are doing.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我有一位朋友，他爸爸一個人住。有一次爸爸經過客廳的時候滑倒了，朋友在公司從手機上看到，馬上請鄰居過去幫忙，才沒有出大事。
lines.simplified: 我有一位朋友，他爸爸一个人住。有一次爸爸经过客厅的时候滑倒了，朋友在公司从手机上看到，马上请邻居过去帮忙，才没有出大事。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí wèi péngyǒu, tā bàba yí ge rén zhù. Yǒu yí cì bàba jīngguò kètīng de shíhòu huá dǎo le, péngyǒu zài gōngsī cóng shǒujī shàng kàn dào, mǎshàng qǐng línjū guòqù bāngmáng, cái méiyǒu chū dà shì.
lines.english: A friend of mine has a father who lives alone. Once his father slipped as he crossed the living room; my friend saw it on his phone at work and at once asked a neighbour to go over and help, so nothing serious happened.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不過，攝影機一方面能讓家人安心，一方面也可能讓老人家覺得不自在，好像一直有人在看著他。
lines.simplified: 不过，摄影机一方面能让家人安心，一方面也可能让老人家觉得不自在，好像一直有人在看着他。
lines.pinyin: Búguò, shèyǐngjī yìfāngmiàn néng ràng jiārén ānxīn, yìfāngmiàn yě kěnéng ràng lǎorénjiā juéde bú zìzài, hǎoxiàng yìzhí yǒu rén zài kànzhe tā.
lines.english: But while a camera can put the family's mind at ease, it can also make an older person uneasy, as if someone were always watching.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 現在一台攝影機才一千多塊，可是也不必每個地方都裝。
lines.simplified: 现在一台摄影机才一千多块，可是也不必每个地方都装。
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài yì tái shèyǐngjī cái yìqiān duō kuài, kěshì yě búbì měi ge dìfāng dōu zhuāng.
lines.english: A camera now costs only a thousand-odd dollars, but there's no need to put one everywhere.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我建議，裝以前一定要先跟家人好好溝通，問問他們的想法。房間、浴室這些地方，最好別裝。
lines.simplified: 我建议，装以前一定要先跟家人好好沟通，问问他们的想法。房间、浴室这些地方，最好别装。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiànyì, zhuāng yǐqián yídìng yào xiān gēn jiārén hǎohǎo gōutōng, wènwen tāmen de xiǎngfǎ. Fángjiān, yùshì zhèxiē dìfāng, zuìhǎo bié zhuāng.
lines.english: My advice: before you put one in, talk it through with your family and ask what they think. Bedrooms and bathrooms are best left without one.

prompt.speaker: N

choices.traditional: 攝影機會讓老人家覺得不自在

choices.pinyin: Shèyǐngjī huì ràng lǎorénjiā juéde bú zìzài.

It is not a warning about living alone, the uneasy feeling comes later after 不過, and the neighbour helped because the son called, not instead of him.

passage.traditional: 我們系主任以前很不習慣用電腦，連電子郵件都很少寄，更別說{1}了。去年颱風來，學校一連停了五天課，他想：「{2}學生的功課都得停下來了。」他只好請同學教他怎麼把教材放上雲端。{3}他發現很好用，現在每次上課前都會先把資料上傳，讓學生預習，請假的同學在家也能看。同學都說這個方法既省時間又有效果，{4}有人上課前就把問題都想好了。不過他也說，雲端{5}方便，學生還是應該來教室上課。{6}資料在雲端上都看得到，有的問題也還是得當面問，才能弄清楚。
passage.simplified: 我们系主任以前很不习惯用电脑，连电子邮件都很少寄，更别说{1}了。去年台风来，学校一连停了五天课，他想：「{2}学生的功课都得停下来了。」他只好请同学教他怎么把教材放上云端。{3}他发现很好用，现在每次上课前都会先把资料上传，让学生预习，请假的同学在家也能看。同学都说这个方法既省时间又有效果，{4}有人上课前就把问题都想好了。不过他也说，云端{5}方便，学生还是应该来教室上课。{6}资料在云端上都看得到，有的问题也还是得当面问，才能弄清楚。
passage.pinyin: Wǒmen xì zhǔrèn yǐqián hěn bù xíguàn yòng diànnǎo, lián diànzǐ yóujiàn dōu hěn shǎo jì, gèng bié shuō zài wǎnglù shàng shàngkè le. Qùnián táifēng lái, xuéxiào yìlián tíng le wǔ tiān kè, tā xiǎng: "Zhèxiàzi xuéshēng de gōngkè dōu děi tíng xiàlái le." Tā zhǐhǎo qǐng tóngxué jiāo tā zěnme bǎ jiàocái fàng shàng yúnduān. Jiéguǒ tā fāxiàn hěn hǎo yòng, xiànzài měi cì shàngkè qián dōu huì xiān bǎ zīliào shàngchuán, ràng xuéshēng yùxí, qǐngjià de tóngxué zài jiā yě néng kàn. Tóngxué dōu shuō zhège fāngfǎ jì shěng shíjiān yòu yǒu xiàoguǒ, shènzhì yǒu rén shàngkè qián jiù bǎ wèntí dōu xiǎng hǎo le. Búguò tā yě shuō, yúnduān jǐnguǎn fāngbiàn, xuéshēng háishì yīnggāi lái jiàoshì shàngkè. Jiùshì zīliào zài yúnduān shàng dōu kàn de dào, yǒu de wèntí yě háishì děi dāngmiàn wèn, cái néng nòng qīngchǔ.
passage.english: The head of our department used to be very uncomfortable with computers. He hardly even sent email, let alone taught online. Last year a typhoon closed the university for five days in a row, and he thought, "Now the students' work will all come to a stop." He had no choice but to ask a student to show him how to put his teaching materials in the cloud. As a result, he found it very handy, and now he uploads the materials before every class, so students can preview them and those who miss class can read them at home. passage.english: My older sister works at a hotel. Guests' details used to be written in a notebook, and if the notebook went missing, the details would be gone too. Last year the hotel switched to a cloud system, and even when she is not at the hotel she can look up guest records on her phone. The system can both work out automatically how much each guest owes and adjust the air conditioning in the rooms, and she says her job is much easier. Then again, the system is not without problems. Last month the power suddenly went out, the internet would not connect, and nothing showed on the computers. They could not even find out who the guests were, let alone how much they owed. The system that was meant to make work easier kept everyone busy for two hours that day instead. Since that day, she writes the details out again in a notebook before leaving work every day.

text.traditional:
我很喜歡照相，十年來拍了一萬多張照片，可是從來沒有好好整理過。以前我都把照片存在隨身碟裡，不過隨身碟很小，很容易不見。有一次搬家，我就弄丟了一個，裡面是我大學四年的照片，我難過了好幾個星期。後來朋友建議我把照片都上傳到雲端，他說這樣就是電腦壞了，照片也不會不見。我覺得這個方法既安全又方便，就把隨身碟裡的照片都放了上去，還把剩下的隨身碟都送給了妹妹。
沒想到去年那家雲端公司的系統出了問題，很多人上傳的資料一下子都沒了，我也有三年的照片再也找不回來。公司只說了一句「對不起」，給每個人一個月的免費空間，就沒有再說什麼了。照片都沒了，給我再多空間又有什麼用？後來，我的朋友有的換了別家公司，有的開始付錢用更好的服務。
現在我還是用雲端，因為它真的很方便，可是重要的照片，我一定會在自己的電腦裡再存一份。我想，雲端只是一個工具，再好的工具也不能完全依靠。
text.simplified:

text.english:
I love taking photos, and in ten years I have taken more than ten thousand, though I have never properly sorted them. I used to keep them on USB drives, but the drives are small and easy to lose. Once, when I moved house, I lost one holding all four years of my university photos, and I was upset for weeks. Later a friend suggested I upload all my photos to the cloud; he said that way, even if my computer broke, the photos would not be lost. I thought this was both safe and convenient, so I put all the photos from my drives up there and even gave my remaining drives to my younger sister.
To my surprise, last year that cloud company's system had a problem, and a lot of people's uploaded data vanished all at once. Three years of my photos are gone for good. The company only said "sorry", gave everyone a free month of space, and said nothing more. With the photos gone, what use is any amount of space? Afterwards, some of my friends switched to another company, and some started paying for a better service.
I still use the cloud, because it really is convenient, but I always save an extra copy of important photos on my own computer. I think the cloud is just a tool, and you can't rely completely on even the best tool.

text.traditional:
我在山區的一所國小教書，學校只有六十幾個學生。以前每年颱風來，山路常常不通，學校一停課就是好幾天，學生的功課也跟著停了下來。三年前，學校跟一家企業合作，企業給每個學生一台平板，老師也開始把教材放上雲端。從那時候起，學生就是不能來學校，也可以在家上課、交功課。
這個方法一方面讓學生不會因為停課而學得比別人慢，一方面也讓家長隨時知道孩子學了什麼。可是剛開始一點也不容易。很多學生的父母在城市工作，孩子住在祖父母家，老人家連平板都不會開，更別說幫孩子上網找資料了。後來我們每個月請家長來學校一次，教他們怎麼用，情況才慢慢好起來。現在，有的老人家還會自己上網看孩子的功課，甚至比孩子還會用平板。
我常想，平板送來的那一天，問題其實才剛開始。
text.simplified:
我在山区的一所国小教书，学校只有六十几个学生。以前每年台风来，山路常常不通，学校一停课就是好几天，学生的功课也跟着停了下来。三年前，学校跟一家企业合作，企业给每个学生一台平板，老师也开始把教材放上云端。从那时候起，学生就是不能来学校，也可以在家上课、交功课。
这个方法一方面让学生不会因为停课而学得比别人慢，一方面也让家长随时知道孩子学了什么。可是刚开始一点也不容易。很多学生的父母在城市工作，孩子住在祖父母家，老人家连平板都不会开，更别说帮孩子上网找资料了。后来我们每个月请家长来学校一次，教他们怎么用，情况才慢慢好起来。现在，有的老人家还会自己上网看孩子的功课，甚至比孩子还会用平板。
我常想，平板送来的那一天，问题其实才刚开始。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài shānqū de yì suǒ guóxiǎo jiāoshū, xuéxiào zhǐyǒu liùshí jǐ ge xuéshēng. Yǐqián měi nián táifēng lái, shānlù chángcháng bù tōng, xuéxiào yì tíngkè jiù shì hǎojǐ tiān, xuéshēng de gōngkè yě gēnzhe tíng le xiàlái. Sān nián qián, xuéxiào gēn yì jiā qìyè hézuò, qìyè gěi měi ge xuéshēng yì tái píngbǎn, lǎoshī yě kāishǐ bǎ jiàocái fàng shàng yúnduān. Cóng nà shíhòu qǐ, xuéshēng jiùshì bù néng lái xuéxiào, yě kěyǐ zài jiā shàngkè, jiāo gōngkè. Zhège fāngfǎ yìfāngmiàn ràng xuéshēng bú huì yīnwèi tíngkè ér xué de bǐ biérén màn, yìfāngmiàn yě ràng jiāzhǎng suíshí zhīdào háizi xué le shénme. Kěshì gāng kāishǐ yìdiǎn yě bù róngyì. Hěn duō xuéshēng de fùmǔ zài chéngshì gōngzuò, háizi zhù zài zǔfùmǔ jiā, lǎorénjiā lián píngbǎn dōu bú huì kāi, gèng bié shuō bāng háizi shàngwǎng zhǎo zīliào le. Hòulái wǒmen měi ge yuè qǐng jiāzhǎng lái xuéxiào yí cì, jiāo tāmen zěnme yòng, qíngkuàng cái mànmàn hǎo qǐlái. Xiànzài, yǒu de lǎorénjiā hái huì zìjǐ shàngwǎng kàn háizi de gōngkè, shènzhì bǐ háizi hái huì yòng píngbǎn. Wǒ cháng xiǎng, píngbǎn sòng lái de nà yì tiān, wèntí qíshí cái gāng kāishǐ.
text.english:
I teach at a primary school in the mountains with only sixty-some pupils. Every year when typhoons came, the mountain roads were often cut, school would close for days at a time, and the pupils' work stopped too. Three years ago the school started working with a company, which gave every pupil a tablet, and the teachers began putting their materials in the cloud. Since then, even when pupils cannot come to school, they can still have lessons and hand in homework at home.
This method on one hand keeps pupils from falling behind because of closures, and on the other lets parents know at any time what their children have learned. But it was not easy at first. Many pupils' parents work in the cities, and the children live with their grandparents, who did not even know how to switch a tablet on, let alone help a child look things up online. Later we invited the parents to the school once a month and taught them how to use it, and only then did things slowly improve. Now some grandparents even check the children's homework online themselves, and use the tablet better than the children do.
I often think that the day the tablets arrived, the real problems had only just begun.
